# zerocake.org — Monzero in Cake Wallet: the XMZ integration, explained

> Guides to the patch that adds Monzero (XMZ), a fork of Monero with a chain of its own, to Cake Wallet: what it adds, BIP39 seeds, nodes, how it was built and tested, and where its pull request stands. Written in English by the people who prepared the patch; not run or endorsed by Cake Wallet or the Monzero project.

How this site works, in four rules:

- **Every figure names where it came from.** Facts about the patch come from the patch and its pull request text; facts about Monzero from its own specification and README. Each guide says which, and when it was checked.
- **Our builds and tests are marked as ours.** A build, a test or a node query says it was ours, with the machine and the toolchain, and what was not tested is listed too.
- **Nothing to download.** The site describes the patch and the build; it does not distribute them.
- **No price talk, and nothing paid for.** No project, exchange or company pays to be mentioned or linked.

## What a reader finds here

- [Guides](https://zerocake.org/guides/): every Monzero guide, newest first.
- [Monzero in Cake Wallet](https://zerocake.org/cake-wallet/): the integration, the build and the pull request.
- [The Monzero network](https://zerocake.org/network/): the coin, its figures and its nodes.
- [Monzero wallet security](https://zerocake.org/security/): seeds shared with Monero and plain-HTTP nodes.
- [About](https://zerocake.org/about/): who writes the guides, and the rules above at length.
- [Everything in one file](https://zerocake.org/llms-full.txt): every page as Markdown. Each page is also at its own address with `.md` appended.

## Where the figures come from

The Monzero patch series for Cake Wallet and its pull request text; Monzero's chain specification and README on GitHub; Cake Wallet's and monero_c's public repositories; and our own build, tests and queries of node.monzero.org, which say they are ours. Each guide names its source and the date it was checked.

## Guides

- [Monzero in Cake Wallet: what the integration adds](https://zerocake.org/guides/monzero-in-cake-wallet/): A six-commit patch adds Monzero (XMZ) to Cake Wallet as a new wallet type, built file for file on the Wownero integration: a wallet package, an XMZ currency with 11 decimals, a default node and Monzero in every screen Wownero reaches. What it adds, and where it follows Monero instead.
- [Monzero BIP39 seeds: one phrase, the same keys as Monero](https://zerocake.org/guides/monzero-bip39-seeds/): In Cake Wallet's Monzero patch a BIP39 phrase is derived on Monero's own path, m/44'/128'/0'/0/0, so one phrase gives the same keys on Monero and on Monzero. What that means for privacy and for funds, and why a Monzero wallet wants a phrase of its own.
- [What is Monzero (XMZ)? The Monero fork, in figures](https://zerocake.org/guides/what-is-monzero/): Monzero (XMZ) is an experimental fork of Monero v0.18.5.x on a chain of its own, started in August 2026: RandomX mining, 11 decimal places, addresses that start with F and a public node on port 6175. Its figures, and the warning its own README gives.
- [Monzero nodes: node.monzero.org and the plain-HTTP RPC](https://zerocake.org/guides/monzero-nodes/): Cake Wallet's Monzero patch ships one default node, node.monzero.org on port 6175, reached over plain HTTP with SSL off. The ports, what plain HTTP exposes, how a restore height is estimated from a date, and what we saw when we queried the node.
- [Building Cake Wallet with Monzero on macOS: what was tested](https://zerocake.org/guides/monzero-cake-wallet-macos-build/): Our build of Cake Wallet with the Monzero patch: a macOS Release app on an Apple Silicon M1 Mac with Xcode 27.1 and Flutter 3.47.8, Dart analysis, 13 passing tests and a check inside the app — and the platforms and flows it did not cover.
- [The Monzero pull request to Cake Wallet, and monero_c](https://zerocake.org/guides/monzero-cake-wallet-pull-request/): Monzero support for Cake Wallet is six commits prepared as one pull request, resting on a second change to monero_c, the library Cake Wallet builds its Monero-family wallets on. The six commits, what has to land first, and what Cake Wallet's maintainers can be expected to ask.
